scripts.build: npm run build:backend && npm run build:frontend
scripts.build:backend: cd backend && bun build src/server.ts --target=bun --outfile dist/server.mjs
scripts.build:frontend: cd frontend && npm run build && bun build server.ts --target=bun --outfile dist/server.js
scripts.dev: npm run build && npx prisma dev module.ts
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run build && npx prisma deploy module.ts --stage preview --json
scripts.deploy:prod: npm run build && npx prisma deploy module.ts --json
